:::{#def-coprecision}
#### Coprecision

Let $\vX$ be a $p \times 1$ [multivariate Gaussian](#def-mvn) vector with $p \ge 2$,
let $i \ne j$,
and let $\vX_{-ij}$ be $\vX$ without its $i$th and $j$th elements.
Write $v_i$ and $v_j$ for the [conditional variances](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-variance) of $X_i$ and $X_j$ given $\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}$,
and $c_{ij}$ for their [conditional covariance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-cov).
The **coprecision** of $X_i$ and $X_j$ given $\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}$ is

$$
\frac{-c_{ij}}{v_i v_j - c_{ij}^2}.
$$

:::
